Publication statement: Chicago ; New York : Rand McNally & Company, 1906-1924.

This record covers single road maps of Alaska published by Rand McNally, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
